title: 雨夜辦公室｜專注工作
checks: 手指有連續打字後離開鍵盤的動作
前景與窗外有相對位移
不得變成日景或新增人物
只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. A continuous live-action shot. In this same Taipei office at night, the same Taiwanese woman with shoulder-length wavy black hair, cream blouse and charcoal cardigan types naturally at her keyboard. At the beginning her fingers alternate on the keys and she glances between two areas of the monitor. She then finishes typing, lifts both hands from the keyboard and exhales, allowing her shoulders to lower. Toward the end she turns her eyes and head down toward the open brown leather notebook on the desk. The camera tracks slowly to the right, keeping her in a medium-wide composition. The nearby desk lamp and notebook shift left faster than the distant window mullions and Taipei skyline. Rain droplets slowly slide down the window; her reflection follows her head movement. Preserve the room, face, wardrobe, practical lamp lighting and cool rainy night. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.000 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room ambience, restrained clothing rustle and physical sounds synchronized to the visible movements; rain and distant traffic are audible only in the office scenes.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
